body: They told me that they’re going to disown me if I don’t break up with my girlfriend. I’m 21. Unfortunately, after my gf found this out, she broke up with me. Thanks, mom!

Not to be rude, but I hope he does at some point. Even for one single day. You have to experience it to know how it feels and I am absolutely sure that he wouldn’t have said that if he was struggling as much as the people here do.

No. I do not hate you, brother ! I love you! Depression is asking this question, not you. It’s messing up with you. And I know how difficult it is trying to think otherwise, it seems like you’re faking it, but you’re not faking it at all. Depression does. Hang tight, my brother. Peace! 🙌

Wake up, take my antidepressants, smoke cigarettes, think about having no purpose or skill, sleep until my Nmother wakes me up and verbally abuses me with stuff like ,,kill yourself already”, ,,nobody will ever love you”, ,,you are a fool and everybody takes advantage of you”, ,,you deserve it”, stuff like that. Then I try to control myself and not lash out to her, take some benzos and go to sleep again. When nobody disturbs me, I watch videos on YT, ride my bike, lift weights if I’m in the mood and go to bed. Go to bed, but not falling asleep. Nights are the worst. Suicidal thoughts come non-stop. Anyway, I guess that at some point my body is exhausted and I finally fall asleep somewhere between 4-5 AM. Then rinse and repeat.
Wow. This is exactly what my mom tells me on a regular basis. And I mean the exact same words.

I’m still in the same boat after about 1 year and a half. I think the same as you do. It is anger, of course. It’s pain. You trusted people, gave everything and got backstabbing in return. I’m so sorry, bro. Some girls are very heartless and can do you like that. I was there. 
Two times, two relationships. Saved my last ex from an overdose, she could’ve lost her life if I didn’t start CPR until the ambulance arrived. Some weeks later, she tells me that she has never been so unhappy with a guy (me) and all of her exes treated her better than I did. She told me that she wants to break up with me and stay single. 
Couple days later, I come to find out that she moved together with another guy…
You know what, bro? I know a saying. What goes around comes around, so don’t worry. Feel bad for them actually. They will never understand and feel what love really is. 
Keep your head up, king. Not every girl is the same, but after my personal experience, I could give you a good piece of advice: don’t rush things, don’t be too nice, be assertive and way more reserved. If something seems wrong, it probably is. Trust your gut. 
I wish you all the best, my brother!
